comparison.objective: Regulate a pendulum to a one-second period, versus setting a gripper to a declared angle and locking it.
comparison.physical_skill: Observe timing and iteratively move a bob; no second tool or locknut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Released pendulum has a one-second full swing.
comparison.reason: Both tune a mechanism and verify performance, but pendulum regulation tests measurement-driven ballast adjustment rather than preserving a threaded setting during locking.
